arguments.note: No design released. For PA12 at a=12 mm, the completed 2,714-cell family-atlas check found zero possible cells satisfying solid fraction <=0.23, E100 >=168 MPa, and a complete gap covering 20.5–30.7 kHz even with favorable calibrated search-tier errors (best optimistic slack -0.2153). Rigorous bounds did not refute the targets, so this is not a proof of physical impossibility. An additional budget-96 search was stopped after an extended wait without returning results; no certificate was obtained.

No design released. Verdict: **NOT_FOUND_IN_FAMILIES**. The amm atlas found no 12 mm PA12 cell meeting all three requirements. This does not prove physical impossibility. The refusal submission was sent, but amm’s acknowledgment remains pending.
